side_prompt: Produce the PRODUCTION side-facing sprite atlas for this original low-resolution wolf. Reference is identity/design only; remove the background. Exactly EIGHT whole-body sprites, ALL facing RIGHT, in a precisely regular FOUR-COLUMN TWO-ROW grid, equal square cells, no labels, no border. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no shadows or ground. Use consistent alignment and scale: each wolf 28 conceptual source pixels long inside a 32x32 cell; paws baseline at row 26 in every cell (including corpse). Strict coarse pixel art, seven flat opaque colors: charcoal outline, deep gray shadow, gray-brown body, medium gray highlight, muted bone muzzle/chest, dark rusty red eye, off-white fang. No blur, gradients, texture, antialiasing, outlines around individual fur hairs or semitransparent edges. Keep heavy angular shoulders, narrow abdomen, long muzzle, low tail and one small red eye. Match head and torso proportions exactly across all eight cels. TOP ROW left to right: 1 neutral standing alert idle, 2 trot contact A (near front paw forward, near hind back; far pair opposite), 3 trot passing A (near front lifts under shoulder, near hind under belly), 4 trot contact B (near front paw back, near hind forward; far pair opposite). BOTTOM ROW left to right: 5 trot passing B (alternate support legs), 6 low compressed threatening crouch with ears back and head lowered, 7 snapping bite with open jaw and extended neck/front legs, 8 dead wolf collapsed fully on side with legs folded and head on ground, eyes CLOSED no red pixel, no blood. Gait poses must visibly change leg placements, not just shift the whole animal. Keep the body largely stable and contact baseline identical so animation does not jitter. Corpse must be same animal scale, not enlarged to fill cell height. Four by two evenly spaced grid ONLY. Big clearly readable square pixel clusters, economical early-console art. Frame-consistent soft overhead RPG viewpoint, not perspective variation.
directions_prompt: Create the PRODUCTION FRONT and REAR sprite atlas for the same original coarse pixel-art charcoal wolf shown in the reference. Exactly TWELVE whole-body sprites in a REGULAR THREE-COLUMN FOUR-ROW grid. Every cell equal size, each animal centered at the same scale, feet on same relative baseline, transparent background with true alpha. No background, shadows, text, grid lines or labels. STRICT COARSE early-console pixel art intended for native 32x32 cells, front wolf only about 13 source pixels wide and 22 high. 7 flat opaque colors maximum: charcoal outline, dark gray shadow, gray-brown body, middle gray highlight, muted tan, bone muzzle/chest, one rusty-red eye pixel. Match the reference's heavy angular shoulders, thin lower legs, tucked waist and pointed ears. TOP TWO ROWS are SOUTH / FRONT-facing towards camera: row1 idle standing front, trot step A with left forepaw forward/right forepaw back and opposite hindlegs, trot step B swapping planted paws. Row2 low threatening windup crouch with head lowered/ears back, snapping bite towards viewer with jaw open and front paws reaching, dead wolf collapsed belly/side with head on the ground towards viewer and eyes CLOSED no red. BOTTOM TWO ROWS are NORTH / REAR-facing away from camera: row3 rear idle showing back/tail, rear trot A alternating hindlegs, rear trot B opposite leg supports. Row4 rear-facing crouch compressed shoulders, rear-facing bite neck reaching away from camera and body stretched, rear-facing corpse with back/tail towards viewer and head fallen away. Never show a face, muzzle or eyes on the rear sprites. Preserve perspective and body scale across all frames. Death sprites are collapsed SHORT silhouettes at the same foot baseline, never enlarged vertically to fill their cells. Simplify fur into solid angular masses with very few pixels, no gradients, blur, semitransparent haze, detailed hair, blood, or smooth rendering. Precisely 3 columns x 4 rows of separate sprites with generous cell padding.
directions_48_revision_prompt: Create a NEW pixel art production sprite sheet of a menacing charcoal wolf for a top-down RPG. The critical requirement is FOUR CLEARLY VISIBLE LEGS on every standing and running wolf, front and back. Do NOT use an eye-level straight front portrait: use elevated THREE-QUARTER TOP-DOWN camera, seeing the long back between neck and hips. Front-facing wolves must show two rear legs sticking out to left and right of the torso, with hind paws around mid-height, plus two forelegs ending at the bottom. This forms FOUR paw endpoints at four corners of a trapezoid. Back-facing wolves must have two front legs visible on the OUTSIDE of the upper torso, with forepaws at mid-height, and two hindlegs ending at bottom flanking tail. Transparent gaps separate each pair of legs on each side. Make the torso narrow enough to see far legs. Anatomically a low horizontal four-legged wolf, never upright/biped. Front head low and angular, pointed ears, lowered brow with tiny red eyes, cream muzzle, gray-brown highlights. Back views no visible eyes. Restrained seven-color palette with near-black outline, charcoal and gray-brown fur, cream accents, red eye pixels. Very simple chunky pixel art, suitable to fit in 48x48 pixels per animal. Genuine transparent background. EXACT grid: 3 columns by 4 rows, each cell equal size, each wolf fully inside own cell with clear margins, no cross-cell overlap. Row1: south/front idle on four paws; south trot A; south trot B with opposite diagonal paw positions. Row2: south crouch windup all four paws spread; south forward open-mouth bite leap with four legs visible; south dead collapsed wolf legs splayed with no red eyes. Row3: north/back idle four paws; north trot A; north trot B. Row4: north crouch all four paws spread; north forward leap with four legs; north dead collapsed wolf. 12 sprites exactly. Same wolf, size and camera in all frames. Four legs must visibly connect to the torso and remain individually readable with clear negative space. No text, grid lines, floor, drop shadow, glow, haze, particles, gradients or antialiasing. Simple confident broad color clusters, no furry texture.
